description: This Java class `AutowiredTenantManagementAdapter` extends `EventBusTenantManagementAdapter` and acts as a Spring component that injects a `TenantManagementService` (qualified as 'backend') via dependency injection. It is used to wire the tenant management service into an event bus-based implementation, likely within a larger device registry project.

classes.name: AutowiredTenantManagementAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that injects a TenantManagementService into an event bus adapter, enabling tenant management within a device registry context.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Injects the TenantManagementService (qualified as 'backend') into the adapter via Spring's @Autowired annotation.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the injected TenantManagementService instance, overriding the parent method for access.
